r: rpmdev-newinit generates new init script from a template

-o FILE
Output the init script to FILE. "-" means stdout. The default is derived from <appname>, or "newinitscript.init" if appname is not given.
-h
Show this usage message and exit.
-v
Print version information and exit.

The template used is /etc/rpmdevtools/template.init.
